## 🎯 Main Idea
- Learn to use `ffuf` for fast web fuzzing to discover hidden content and inputs on web apps.
- Enumerate directories, files, extensions, parameters, and values a site does not link to.
- Discover DNS sub-domains and virtual hosts (VHosts) that share an IP.
- Filter and tune results to cut noise and zero in on valid responses.

## 💥 Attack / Exploit Vectors
### Web Fuzzing Basics
- Replace the part of a request to test with the `FUZZ` keyword and feed it a wordlist with `-w`.
- **Commands**
  - `ffuf -h` — show ffuf help/options
  - `ffuf -w wordlist.txt:FUZZ -u http://SERVER_IP:PORT/FUZZ` — basic fuzz at FUZZ position

### Directory Fuzzing
- Brute-force directory/folder names to find unlinked paths.
- **Commands**
  - `ffuf -w wordlist.txt:FUZZ -u http://SERVER_IP:PORT/FUZZ` — directory fuzzing
  - `/opt/useful/seclists/Discovery/Web-Content/directory-list-2.3-small.txt` — directory/page wordlist

### Extension Fuzzing
- Discover which file extensions the server serves (.php, .html, .bak, etc.).
- **Commands**
  - `ffuf -w wordlist.txt:FUZZ -u http://SERVER_IP:PORT/indexFUZZ` — fuzz the extension after a known filename
  - `/opt/useful/seclists/Discovery/Web-Content/web-extensions.txt` — extensions wordlist

### Page Fuzzing
- Enumerate page/file names within a known directory using a known extension.
- **Commands**
  - `ffuf -w wordlist.txt:FUZZ -u http://SERVER_IP:PORT/blog/FUZZ.php` — page fuzzing

### Recursive Fuzzing
- Automatically fuzz newly found directories to a set depth instead of repeating manually.
- **Commands**
  - `ffuf -w wordlist.txt:FUZZ -u http://SERVER_IP:PORT/FUZZ -recursion -recursion-depth 1 -e .php -v` — recursive fuzz, depth 1, append .php, verbose

### DNS Records / Sub-domain Fuzzing
- Brute-force sub-domains of a target domain by fuzzing the host portion.
- **Commands**
  - `ffuf -w wordlist.txt:FUZZ -u https://FUZZ.hackthebox.eu/` — sub-domain fuzzing
  - `/opt/useful/seclists/Discovery/DNS/subdomains-top1million-5000.txt` — DNS/subdomain wordlist

### VHost Fuzzing
- Finds virtual hosts on the same IP by fuzzing the `Host:` header (works even when DNS has no record, unlike subdomain fuzzing which relies on public DNS resolution).
- **Commands**
  - `ffuf -w wordlist.txt:FUZZ -u http://academy.htb:PORT/ -H 'Host: FUZZ.academy.htb' -fs xxx` — VHost fuzzing (filter default-page size)

### Filtering Results
- Reduce noise by matching/filtering on size, words, lines, or status codes.
- **Commands**
  - `-fs xxx` — filter out responses of size xxx (also `-fc` status code, `-fw` word count, `-fl` line count; `-mc` matches codes)

### Parameter Fuzzing - GET
- Discover hidden GET parameters accepted by a page.
- **Commands**
  - `ffuf -w wordlist.txt:FUZZ -u http://admin.academy.htb:PORT/admin/admin.php?FUZZ=key -fs xxx` — GET parameter fuzzing
  - `/opt/useful/seclists/Discovery/Web-Content/burp-parameter-names.txt` — parameters wordlist

### Parameter Fuzzing - POST
- Discover hidden POST body parameters.
- **Commands**
  - `ffuf -w wordlist.txt:FUZZ -u http://admin.academy.htb:PORT/admin/admin.php -X POST -d 'FUZZ=key' -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' -fs xxx` — POST parameter fuzzing

### Value Fuzzing
- Once a valid parameter is found, brute-force its accepted values (e.g. IDs).
- **Commands**
  - `ffuf -w ids.txt:FUZZ -u http://admin.academy.htb:PORT/admin/admin.php -X POST -d 'id=FUZZ' -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' -fs xxx` — value fuzzing
  - `for i in $(seq 1 1000); do echo $i >> ids.txt; done` — create a sequential value wordlist

### General Commands
- `sudo sh -c 'echo "SERVER_IP academy.htb" >> /etc/hosts'` — add DNS entry to /etc/hosts (needed for subdomain/vhost access)
- `curl http://admin.academy.htb:PORT/admin/admin.php -X POST -d 'id=key' -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded'` — manually confirm a finding with curl POST

## 🛠️ Key Tools & Concepts
- ffuf — fast web fuzzer; the `FUZZ` keyword marks the injection point
- `-w` — wordlist (append `:FUZZ` to name the keyword), `-u` URL, `-X` method, `-d` POST data, `-H` custom header, `-e` extensions, `-recursion`/`-recursion-depth`
- Filtering flags — `-fs`/`-fc`/`-fw`/`-fl` filter and `-mc` match by size/code/words/lines
- SecLists — wordlist collection: directory-list for dirs/pages, web-extensions for extensions, subdomains-top1million for DNS, burp-parameter-names for params
- Subdomain vs VHost — subdomain fuzzing resolves via public DNS; VHost fuzzing manipulates the Host header to reach non-public hosts on the same IP
- /etc/hosts — map discovered vhosts/subdomains to the target IP
